title: Peekable Anchor Help Strips for Console Quickstarts
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact, anchorable help pattern called 'Peekable Anchor Help Strips' that surfaces contextual doc links, short how-to screenshots, and one-line tips across Console surfaces. Strips should be minimally obtrusive, support keyboard and screen-reader access, and expand to show 2-3 actionable links with a single inline screenshot or animated GIF. Primary pages: Model versioning modal, Dedicated capacity setup, Private deployment quickstart, and the Rollouts UI.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity comps for desktop and tablet for each primary page (4 pages)
Accessible keyboard interactions documented (focus order, enter/space to expand, esc to collapse)
Copy for collapsed state (<= 4 words) and expanded state (<= 2 short links + 1 CTA)
PNG screenshots (3 sizes) captured for each contextual screenshot usage and annotated with callouts
Design tokens and specs exported to Figma + handoff sheet with CSS variables
Usability test with 6 participants shows at least 80% completion of quickstart task with help strip visible
decisions: Use horizontal anchor strip (edge-attached) vs floating card to avoid overlap with existing tooltips
Limit expansions to a single row of content (no nested panels) to keep latency low and reduce cognitive load
Prioritize keyboard-first controls and ARIA attributes over hover-only affordances
Show analytics hook (click/expand) for each strip for tracking adoption and later A/B testing
screenshots_needed: Dedicated capacity create flow - step showing pool selection (desktop)
Private deployment quickstart - network config panel with callout (tablet)
Rollouts UI - canary toggle and traffic slider (desktop)
Model versioning modal - pin version dropdown (desktop)
Compact screenshot variations: default, with annotation overlay, with blurred sensitive fields
